caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a fitted lid, positioned upright in the center of a blank, light beige background. The container has a knob at the top of the lid for gripping. The body and lid of the container are decorated with ornate, symmetrical patterns made up of stylized floral and leaf motifs. The primary colors used in the decoration are muted green, brown, and earthy red tones, with the floral elements and lines executed in brown and red, creating contrast against the green background. The rim of the lid, the horizontal band across the top of the container, and the base are highlighted with brown lines. The central motif on the body resembles a large, stylized flower flanked by leaf-like swirls. The lid’s decorations echo the color palette and motifs of the container body. The overall composition centers the container against an empty background with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Pennsylvania German Covered Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
